summaries.ko: 12·3 비상계엄 가담 혐의를 받는 한덕수 전 국무총리가 항소심에서 1심보다 8년 줄어든 징역 15년을 선고받았다.
summaries.en: Former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo, facing charges of involvement in the December 3rd emergency martial law, was sentenced to 15 years in prison by the appellate court, an 8-year reduction from his first-instance sentence.
summaries.zh: 因涉嫌参与12·3紧急戒严，前国务总理韩德洙在二审中被判处有期徒刑15年，相比一审减少了8年。
